# NOTES.md — ledgerd

## Project Context

ledgerd serves balances and transaction history to the mobile app (~40k daily users) and to 6 partner integrations over HTTP.

comments: # Partners register one HTTPS endpoint each. Delivery is at-least-once; the

# 4xx: our request is bad; retrying won't change the answer.
# Full jitter so three replicas retrying the same partner don't sync up.
